items.question: What is Kancara?
items.answer: Kancara is a multi-agent travel companion for groups with different needs, from planning all the way to the trip home. It builds the plan from every member's needs instead of the loudest voice.

items.question: Who is Kancara for?
items.answer: Anyone who travels with other people: families with elderly relatives or toddlers, groups of friends, and tour leaders. One plan can hold 1 to 50 people.

items.question: Which needs can be recorded?
items.answer: For each member you can record mobility needs such as a wheelchair, food choices such as halal, vegetarian, or vegan, allergies, rest times, and sensitivity to noise or crowds. A need that is not on the list can be typed in.

items.question: How does Kancara work?
items.answer: Enter the route, dates, pace, group members, and budget. Captain, Kancara's AI assistant, then builds a day-by-day itinerary and marks which needs are met and which still need a check.

items.question: Does the budget have to be in Rupiah?
items.answer: No. The budget can be entered in Rupiah or US dollars, and Kancara works out the other amount with the daily exchange rate.

items.question: Which languages is Kancara available in?
items.answer: Indonesian and English. You can switch at any time with the ID and EN buttons.

cta.title: Ready to set off with your group?
cta.body: Tell Captain about your trip. We'll help put the rest together.
